result.summary: This residential street lacks any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks or marked crossings, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles. The environment is characterized by low-density housing and mature landscaping that may obstruct sightlines at driveway entrances.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walkway exists, forcing people to walk in the travel lane or on uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the street edges on both sides.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Landscaping
hazards.description: Tall, dense hedges near the roadway edge can block sightlines between drivers exiting driveways and pedestrians in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, adjacent to the driveway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Implement height restrictions for hedges and shrubs near the roadway to maintain clear sight triangles.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Ensure lighting levels are adequate for pedestrian visibility at night, especially given the lack of sidewalks.

result.summary: This residential street lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks or marked crossings, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles. Tall hedges near the roadway create potential sightline obstructions between drivers and pedestrians entering the street.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian facilities

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges along the property line may obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians separated from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Improve Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add more street lights to ensure the roadway and potential pedestrian paths are well-lit at night.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Encourage or require the trimming of tall hedges near the street to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a low-density residential street with single-family homes and no dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, crosswalks, or street lights visible, forcing pedestrians to use the roadway or grass verges.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk in the roadway or on uneven grass, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street throughout the visible area.

hazards.name: Absence of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights, which reduces visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Add Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly underdeveloped, lacking sidewalks and marked crosswalks in a residential setting. Pedestrians must walk on the grass or share the roadway with vehicles, and sightlines are partially obstructed by mature trees and vegetation.

hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walkway, forcing people to walk in the street or on uneven grass.

hazards.name: Faded/Missing Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The stop bar is faded and there are no marked crosswalks, reducing driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.
